title: Timbaland Debuts First Music Video From His AI-Generated Artist, TaTa Taktumi (Vibe)
notes: Vibe (Regina Cho), 2025-10-10. TaTa Taktumi 'Glitch x Pulse' MV = futuristic, dancing robots, spaceship, Jabbawockeez. Produced by Timbaland / Stage Zero. TaTa = pink-haired virtual persona, NOT Black female. Timbaland: 'not an avatar... autonomous music artist built with AI... first icon of A-Pop.' Contrast case for Q8.
